annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: April 15 each year (statutory; not read on an official page today)

sources.title: NC Secretary of State - Business Registration fees

entity_level_taxes.name: Franchise tax (S corporations)
entity_level_taxes.notes: $200 for the first $1,000,000 of tax base, plus $1.50 per $1,000 above $1,000,000. Applies to S corporations (corporations), not to LLCs taxed as partnerships/disregarded.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: North Carolina taxed pass-through entity election for partnerships and S corporations exists; rate and details not read on an official page today.

sources.title: NCDOR - Corporate Income and Franchise Tax Rates
sources.quote: the franchise tax rate for S corporations is $200 for the first $1,000,000 of the corporation's tax base and $1.50 per $1,000

personal_exemption.notes: No personal exemption. No extra standard deduction for age 65+/blind.

sources.title: NCDOR - Tax rate schedules
sources.quote: For Taxable Years after 2025, the North Carolina individual income tax rate is 3.99% (0.0399).

sources.title: NCDOR - NC Standard Deduction
sources.quote: Single $12,750 ... Married Filing Jointly/Qualifying Widow(er)/Surviving Spouse $25,500

estimated_tax.required_if: tax due after NC withholding and credits is $1,000 or more
estimated_tax.notes: January payment not needed if return filed and balance paid by January 31.

unemployment_2026.notes: New employer standard beginning rate 1.000%; wage base $34,200 for 2026 (was $32,600 in 2025).

notable: Flat rate cut to 3.99% for 2026 (4.25% in 2025) (https://www.ncdor.gov/taxes-forms/individual-income-tax/tax-rate-schedules)
LLC annual report costs $200 every year (https://www.sosnc.gov/fees/by_title/_Business_Registration)
